ap-stats.name: IITC plugin: Available AP statistics
ap-stats.description: Displays the per-team AP gains available in the current view.
ap-stats.author: Hollow011

basemap-blank.name: IITC plugin: Blank map
basemap-blank.description: Add a blank map layer - no roads or other features.
basemap-blank.author: jonatkins

basemap-gaode.name: IITC plugin: Gaode (楂樺痉鍦板浘) / AutoNavi map
basemap-gaode.description: Map layers from AutoNavi / Gaode (楂樺痉鍦板浘)
basemap-gaode.author: johnd0e

basemap-google-gray.name: IITC plugin: Gray Google map
basemap-google-gray.description: Add a simplified gray Version of Google map tiles as an optional layer.
basemap-google-gray.author: jacob1123

basemap-openstreetmap.name: IITC plugin: OpenStreetMap.org map
basemap-openstreetmap.description: Add the native OpenStreetMap.org map tiles as an optional layer.
basemap-openstreetmap.author: jonatkins

basemap-stamen.name: IITC plugin: Stamen.com map layers
basemap-stamen.description: Add the 'Toner' and 'Watercolor' map layers from maps.stamen.com.
basemap-stamen.author: jonatkins

basemap-yandex.name: IITC plugin: Yandex maps
basemap-yandex.description: Add Yandex.com (Russian/袪褍褋褋泻懈泄) map layers
basemap-yandex.author: johnd0e

bookmarks.name: IITC plugin: Bookmarks for maps and portals
bookmarks.description: Save your favorite Maps and Portals and move the intel map with a click. Works with sync. Supports Multi-Project-Extension
bookmarks.author: ZasoGD

cache-portals-on-map.name: IITC plugin: Cache viewed portals on map
cache-portals-on-map.description: Cache the details of recently viewed portals and use this to populate the map when possible
cache-portals-on-map.author: jonatkins

cross-links.name: IITC plugin: Cross links
cross-links.description: Checks for existing links that cross planned links. Requires draw-tools plugin.
cross-links.author: mcben

debug-raw-portal-data.name: IITC plugin: Debug: Raw portal JSON data
debug-raw-portal-data.description: Developer debugging aid: Add a link to the portal details to show the raw data of a portal.
debug-raw-portal-data.author: jonatkins

distance-to-portal.name: IITC plugin: Distance to portal
distance-to-portal.description: Allows your current location to be set manually, then shows the distance to the selected portal. Useful when managing portal keys.
distance-to-portal.author: jonatkins

done-links.name: IITC plugin: Done links
done-links.description: A companion to the Cross Links plugin. Highlights any links that match existing draw-tools line/polygon edges
done-links.author: jonatkins

draw-tools.name: IITC plugin: Draw tools
draw-tools.description: Allow drawing things onto the current map so you may plan your next move. Supports Multi-Project-Extension.
draw-tools.author: breunigs

farms-find.name: IITC plugin: Find farms on map

fix-china-map-offset.name: IITC plugin: Fix maps offsets in China
fix-china-map-offset.description: Show correct maps for China user by applying offset tweaks.
fix-china-map-offset.author: modos189

fly-links.name: IITC plugin: Fly Links
fly-links.description: Calculate how to link the portals to create the largest tidy set of nested fields. Enable from the layer chooser.
fly-links.author: Fly33

hide-portal-levels.name: IITC plugin: Hide portal levels
hide-portal-levels.description: Replace all levels with single layerChooser's entry; reverting on longclick
hide-portal-levels.author: johnd0e

highlight-forgotten.name: IITC plugin: Highlight inactive portals
highlight-forgotten.description: Use the portal fill color to denote if the portal is unclaimed with no recent activity. Shades of red from one week to one month, then tinted to purple for longer. May also highlight captured portals that are stuck and fail to decay every 24 hours.
highlight-forgotten.author: jonatkins

highlight-hide-team.name: IITC plugin: Hide portal ownership
highlight-hide-team.description: Show all portals as neutral, as if uncaptured. Great for creating plans.
highlight-hide-team.author: vita10gy

highlight-high-level.name: IITC plugin: Highlight high level portals
highlight-high-level.description: Use the portal fill color to denote high level portals: Purple L8, Red L7, Orange L6
highlight-high-level.author: jonatkins

highlight-level-color.name: IITC plugin: Highlight portals by level color
highlight-level-color.description: Use the portal fill color to denote the portal level by using the game level colors.
highlight-level-color.author: vita10gy

highlight-missing-resonators.name: IITC plugin: Highlight portals missing resonators
highlight-missing-resonators.description: Use the portal fill color to denote if the portal is missing resonators.
highlight-missing-resonators.author: vita10gy

highlight-moved-portals.name: IITC plugin: Highlight moved portals
highlight-moved-portals.description: Highlights portals with links with different location data
highlight-moved-portals.author: screach

highlight-needs-recharge.name: IITC plugin: Highlight portals that need recharging
highlight-needs-recharge.description: Use the portal fill color to denote if the portal needs recharging and how much. Yellow: above 85%. Orange: above 70%. Red: above 15%. Magenta: below 15%.
highlight-needs-recharge.author: vita10gy

highlight-ornaments.name: IITC plugin: Highlight portals with ornaments
highlight-ornaments.description: Use the portal fill color to denote portals with additional 'ornament' markers. e.g. Anomaly portals
highlight-ornaments.author: jonatkins

highlight-portal-history.name: IITC plugin: Highlight portals based on history
highlight-portal-history.description: Use the portal fill color to denote the portal has been visited, captured, scout controlled
highlight-portal-history.author: Johtaja

highlight-portals-my-level.name: IITC plugin: Highlight portals by my level
highlight-portals-my-level.description: Use the portal fill color to denote if the portal is either at and above, or at and below your level.
highlight-portals-my-level.author: vita10gy

highlight-weakness.name: IITC plugin: Highlight portal weakness
highlight-weakness.description: Use the fill color of the portals to denote if the portal is weak. Stronger red indicates recharge required, missing resonators, or both.
highlight-weakness.author: vita10gy

keys-on-map.name: IITC plugin: Keys on map
keys-on-map.description: Show the manually entered key counts from the 'keys' plugin on the map.
keys-on-map.author: xelio

keys.name: IITC plugin: Keys
keys.description: Allow manual entry of key counts for each portal. Use the 'keys-on-map' plugin to show the numbers on the map, and 'sync' to share between multiple browsers or desktop/mobile.
keys.author: xelio

layer-count.name: IITC plugin: Layer count
layer-count.description: Allow users to count nested fields
layer-count.author: fkloft

link-show-direction.name: IITC plugin: Direction of links on map
link-show-direction.description: Show the direction of links on the map by adding short dashes to the line at the origin portal.
link-show-direction.author: jonatkins

linked-portals-show.name: IITC plugin: Linked portals
linked-portals-show.description: Try to show the linked portals (image, name and link direction) in portal detail view and jump to linked portal on click.  Some details may not be available if the linked portal is not in the current view.
linked-portals-show.author: fstopienski

links-to-moved-portals.name: IITC plugin: Links to moved portals
links-to-moved-portals.description: Show links to portals with different location data
links-to-moved-portals.author: screach

machina-tools.name: IITC plugin: Machina Tools
machina-tools.description: Machina investigation tools - 2 new layers to see possible Machina spread and portal detail links to display Machina cluster information and to navigate to parent or seed Machina portal
machina-tools.author: Perringaiden

minimap.name: IITC plugin: Mini map
minimap.description: Show a mini map on the corner of the map.
minimap.author: johnd0e

missions.name: IITC plugin: Missions
missions.description: View missions. Marking progress on waypoints/missions basis. Showing mission paths on the map.
missions.author: jonatkins

multi-projects-extension.name: IITC plugin: Multi Projects Extension
multi-projects-extension.description: Create separated projects in some plugins.
multi-projects-extension.author: ZasoGD

ornament-icons-extended.name: IITC plugin: Ornament icons extended
ornament-icons-extended.description: Additonal icons and names for beacons
ornament-icons-extended.author: johtata

ornament-icons.name: IITC plugin: Ornament icons basic
ornament-icons.description: Add own icons and names for ornaments
ornament-icons.author: johtata

overlay-kml.name: IITC plugin: Overlay KML / GPX / GeoJSON
overlay-kml.description: Allow users to overlay their own KML / GPX / GeoJSON files on top of IITC.
overlay-kml.author: danielatkins

pan-control.name: IITC plugin: Pan control
pan-control.description: Show a panning control on the map.
pan-control.author: fragger

periodic-refresh.name: IITC plugin: Periodic refresh
periodic-refresh.description: For use for unattended display screens only, this plugin causes idle mode to be left once per hour.
periodic-refresh.author: jonatkins

player-activity-tracker.name: IITC plugin: Player activity tracker
player-activity-tracker.description: Draw trails for the path a user took onto the map based on status messages in COMMs. Uses up to three hours of data. Does not request chat data on its own, even if that would be useful.
player-activity-tracker.author: breunigs

player-level-guess.name: IITC plugin: Player level guess
player-level-guess.description: Try to determine player levels from the data available in the current view.
player-level-guess.author: breunigs

portal-counts.name: IITC plugin: Portal count
portal-counts.description: Display a list of all localized portals by level and faction.
portal-counts.author: yenky

portal-level-numbers.name: IITC plugin: Portal Level Numbers
portal-level-numbers.description: Show portal level numbers on map.
portal-level-numbers.author: rongou

portal-names.name: IITC plugin: Portal Names
portal-names.description: Show portal names on the map.
portal-names.author: ZasoGD

portals-list.name: IITC plugin: Portals list
portals-list.description: Display a sortable list of all visible portals with full details about the team, resonators, links, etc.
portals-list.author: teo96

privacy-view.name: IITC plugin: Privacy view on Intel
privacy-view.description: Hide info from intel which shouldn't leak to players of the other faction.
privacy-view.author: johnd0e

remove-extra-layers.name: IITC plugin: Remove extra layers
remove-extra-layers.description: Remove 'Artifacts', 'Beacons' and 'Frackers' from layerChooser (still keeping them on map)
remove-extra-layers.author: johnd0e

reso-energy-pct.name: IITC plugin: Reso energy % in portal details
reso-energy-pct.description: Show resonator energy percentage on resonator energy bar in portal details panel.
reso-energy-pct.author: xelio

scale-bar.name: IITC plugin: Scale bar
scale-bar.description: Show scale bar on the map.
scale-bar.author: breunigs

score-cycle-times.name: IITC plugin: Scoring cycle / checkpoint times
score-cycle-times.description: Show the times used for the septicycle and checkpoints for regional scoreboards.
score-cycle-times.author: jonatkins

scoreboard.name: IITC plugin: Localized scoreboard
scoreboard.description: Display a scoreboard about all visible portals with statistics about both teams,like average portal level,link & field counts etc.
scoreboard.author: Costaspap

scroll-wheel-zoom-disable.name: IITC plugin: Disable mouse wheel zoom
scroll-wheel-zoom-disable.description: Disable the use of mouse wheel to zoom. The map zoom controls or keyboard are still available.
scroll-wheel-zoom-disable.author: jonatkins

sync.name: IITC plugin: Sync
sync.description: Sync data between clients via Google Drive API. Only syncs data from specific plugins (currently: Keys, Bookmarks, Uniques). Sign in via the 'Sync' link. Data is synchronized every 3 minutes.
sync.author: xelio

tidy-links.name: IITC plugin: Tidy Links
tidy-links.description: Calculate how to link the portals to create a reasonably tidy set of links/fields. Enable from the layer chooser. (former `Max Links`)
tidy-links.author: boombuler

uniques.name: IITC plugin: Uniques
uniques.description: Allow manual entry of portals visited/captured. Use the 'highlighter-uniques' plugin to show the uniques on the map, and 'sync' to share between multiple browsers or desktop/mobile. It will try and guess which portals you have captured from COMM/portal details, but this will not catch every case.
uniques.author: 3ch01c

user-location.name: IITC plugin: User Location
user-location.description: Show user location marker on map
user-location.author: cradle

wayfarer-range.name: IITC plugin: Wayfarer portal submission range
wayfarer-range.description: Add a 20m range around portals and drawn markers, to aid Wayfarer portals submissions
wayfarer-range.author: morph

zaprange.name: IITC plugin: Zaprange
zaprange.description: Shows the maximum range of attack by the portals.
zaprange.author: ZasoGD

zoom-slider.name: IITC plugin: Zoom slider
zoom-slider.description: Show a zoom slider on the map instead of the zoom buttons.
zoom-slider.author: fragger
